utv.uk.title: Die Another Day - Die Another Day
utv.uk.description: The 20th entry in the James Bond film series and Pierce Brosnan's final appearance as the secret agent. 007 is assigned to North Korea on a mission to assassinate a colonel when he is betrayed by a double agent at MI6 and captured - after enduring 14 months of torture, James is traded at the Korean border for Zao, a North Korean agent and associate of the colonel, in a prisoner exchange. Bond then escapes his subsequent MI6 detention and tracks Zao to Havana where he meets NSA agent Jinx and learns that she is working on the same case - James soon discovers that Zao is in league with the British diamond and technology tycoon Sir Gustav Graves... and that the two are planning to use a new satellite called Icarus to change the power balance of the world permanently.

utv.uk.description: Chizzy Akudolu hosts the classic panel show with a twist as four fantastically funny guests join team leaders Richard Blackwood and Eddie Kadi to take viewers on a tour of Black British history - this time it's Jonathan Ross, Gbemi Oladipo, Sukh Ojla and Remel London joining the team leaders. itv1anglia.uk.title: EFL Live : Burnley v Blackburn Rovers
itv1anglia.uk.description: S3 E4 Burnley v Blackburn Rovers (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents coverage of the Championship match from Turf Moor, as the rivals face each other in the East Lancashire derby. There have been 170 previous meetings between these teams in all competitions, dating back to the 1888/89 season, and it is the Clarets who narrowly hold the better record with 71 wins to Rovers 65, with the other 34 games ending in draws. The most recent meeting was in the 2024/25 campaign and saw Burnley triumph 1-0 at Ewood Park, with the corresponding clash here ending in a 1-1 stalemate. With analysis from Ben Mee and Brad Friedel, commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward, and reports from Katie Shanahan.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Die Another Day
itv1anglia.uk.description: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry and Toby Stephens. After being betrayed during an operation in North Korea, agent James Bond is held prisoner by a ruthless military leader. A trade-off secures Bond's freedom, but his "00" agent status is withdrawn when he is suspected of leaking secret information. Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

itv1angliawest.uk.description: This premium sports documentary tells the stranger-than-fiction story of the only manager in British football to ever be appointed by a phone vote. The story of a chairman inspired by Pop Idol in a bid to win over fans, during a summer where the money men and fans went to battle for control of Luton Town football club. In 2003, Luton Town were in crisis. New chairman John Gurney was the face of a mystery consortium that turned fans against their own club. Luton Town fans rose up against their own chairman - forging a maverick plot to buy the club's debt and put their own club into administration - to oust the chairman and change the club's future. This is the nightmare origin story of a fan movement that would turn into a dream. The fans that fought for the future of their club, led it on a historic journey from non league all the way to the promised land and riches of the ⚽ [EPL] Premier League. (Special, Documentary, Soccer) - 20261122

stvnorth.uk.description: S8 E31 Joining Alan at Manor Farm this time are Chelsea Detective stars Adrian Scarborough and Vanessa Emme, and farmers Kelvin and Liz Fletcher. stvnorth.uk.title: EFL Live : Burnley v Blackburn Rovers
stvnorth.uk.description: S3 E4 Burnley v Blackburn Rovers (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents coverage of the Championship match from Turf Moor, as the rivals face each other in the East Lancashire derby. There have been 170 previous meetings between these teams in all competitions, dating back to the 1888/89 season, and it is the Clarets who narrowly hold the better record with 71 wins to Rovers 65, with the other 34 games ending in draws. The most recent meeting was in the 2024/25 campaign and saw Burnley triumph 1-0 at Ewood Park, with the corresponding clash here ending in a 1-1 stalemate. With analysis from Ben Mee and Brad Friedel, commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward, and reports from Katie Shanahan.

stvnorth.uk.title: Die Another Day

After being betrayed during an operation in North Korea, agent James Bond is held prisoner by a ruthless military leader. A trade-off secures Bond's freedom, but his "00" agent status is withdrawn when he is suspected of leaking secret information. Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E13 — Spin a Yarn Gordon Ramsay travels to Fremont, California, to try to save a restaurant that is tearing the owners' marriage apart. Saki Kavouniaris took over the failing Spin-a-Yarn restaurant in 1995 and began to turn it into a success. He fell in love with a waitress, but the restaurant and the marriage are now failing. (Reality, Cookery) - 2011

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S5 E1 — La Galleria 33 Part 1 Gordon heads to Boston for the first of two visits to La Galleria 33, an Italian restaurant opened in 2006 by raucous sisters Rita and Lisa. The two siblings grew up working at their father's successful restaurant nearby, but when they opened their own establishment, the customers didn't materialise. The sisters blame everything from the weather to the tablecloths for their failures. (Reality, Cookery) - 2012

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S5 E2 — La Galleria 33 Part 2 Gordon confronts restaurant owners and sisters Rita and Lisa with an ultimatum. His stand-off with the siblings is just the beginning of the explosive action. He finds himself stuck in a war between the waiters, chefs and owners over who is to blame for the restaurant's failings. Can Gordon wrangle these hapless proprietors and stubborn employees back into one productive team and save the restaurant? (Reality, Cookery) - 2012

E4+1.uk.title: The Great British Bake Off
E4+1.uk.description: S17 E9 — Patisserie Week It's the semi-final and time for the bakers to showcase their patisserie prowess. Their precision, patience and pastry skills are pushed to the limit as they strive to prove they have what it takes to make it through to the final. (Competition reality, Cookery) - 2026

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E14 — Brother From the Same Planet When Homer is late picking up Bart from a school football game, Bart protests by hooking himself up with Tom, a surrogate dad from an agency. Stung by being jilted by his own son, Homer gets into a monster brawl with Tom that even makes the news. (Animation, Sitcom) - 1992

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E15 — I Love Lisa Valentine's Day comes to Springfield and Lisa takes pity on Ralph and gives him a card, but when Ralph falls in love with Lisa their friendship turns bad, causing a bitter feud to break out between the two families. (Animation, Sitcom) - 1992

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E16 — Duffless After Homer fails a breathalyser test-driving home from a visit to the Duff brewery, he is forced to quit drinking for a month. Meanwhile, Lisa buys a hamster for her school science project, in order to prove that Bart is dumber than a rodent. (Animation, Sitcom) - 1992

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E17 — Last Exit to Springfield Homer takes on Mr Burns in a labour struggle that rapidly spirals out of control. When Homer leads the workers out on strike, Mr Burns retaliates by hiring robots to replace them and shutting off power to the city. (Animation, Sitcom) - 1992

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S12 E8 — Skinner's Sense of Snow When a huge snowdrift engulfs the school, the kids rebel, gagging Principal Skinner, tying him to a chair and running amok. Meanwhile, Homer and Flanders' rescue operation is going disastrously, and the fate of Skinner and the kids rests in the paws of a lone hamster. (Animation, Sitcom) - 2000

E4+1.uk.title: Turner & Hooch
E4+1.uk.description: Detective Scott Turner is an uptight, by-the-book police officer who hopes to leave his sleepy California town and work in the big city. When his friend Amos Reed, the proprietor of a junkyard, is killed, Turner reluctantly inherits the man's dog. Realising that the canine may be able to help him solve the murder case, Turner attempts to adjust to life with the big dog, resulting in much household destruction and unwelcome chaos. (Film, Comedy) - 1989

E4+1.uk.title: The Great British Bake Off
E4+1.uk.description: The Great New Year Bake Off Some familiar faces from Bake Off past battle it out over three seasonal challenges to see who will win the first Star Baker crown of 2023. And then to see the New Year in, the bakers and their family and friends are entertained by Riverdance. (Competition reality, Cookery) - 2023

E4+1.uk.title: One Born Every Minute ᴺᵉʷ
E4+1.uk.description: S12 E5 — Episode 5 Grace and Bailey get ready to meet their baby after a difficult pregnancy. Faith and Femi have a challenging labour. Charlotte and Alex prep for baby number two. (Documentary, Medical) - 2026

E4+1.uk.title: Plane
E4+1.uk.description: Pilot Brodie Torrance saves passengers from a lightning strike by making a risky landing on a war-torn island. When dangerous rebels take the passengers hostage, Torrance seeks help from an accused murderer who was being transported by the FBI. (Film, Action) - 2023

E4+1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4+1.uk.description: S23 E2 — Episode 2 The Goggleboxers spend a night on the sofa watching 'Wheel of Fortune', 'Trigger Point', 'Michael McIntyre's Big Show', 'Boarders', 'Love Is Blind', 'The Pet Psychic: What's Your Dog Thinking?' and BBC News on UK by-elections and Donald Trump. E4+1.uk.title: Not Okay
E4+1.uk.description: A misguided young woman who is desperate for friends and fame fakes a trip to Paris to update her social media presence. A terrifying incident takes place in the real world, which becomes a part of the imaginary trip and offers all she wants. (Film, Comedy) - 2022

cinemax.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemax.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Comedy drama, Biography, Docudrama) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: The Biggest Little Farm
cinemax.us.description: A couple are followed through their successes and failures as they work to develop a sustainable farm on 200 acres outside of Los Angeles. (Documentary) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Lobster
cinemax.us.description: In a dystopian society, single people must find a mate within 45 days or be transformed into an animal of their choice. (Romantic comedy, Fantasy, Drama, Romance, Science fiction) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: The Apparition
cinemax.us.description: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemax.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy) - 2020

cinemax.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemax.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: A U.S. newsman (Raymond Burr) in Tokyo recounts the story of a huge dinosaur roused from the sea by an atomic blast. (movie) - 1956

cinemaxaction.us.title: Son of Godzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: In this Japanese monster movie, the massive Godzilla comes to the aid of his newborn son, who hatches from an egg on a remote island where scientists are conducting experiments with radioactivity. Revealing a surprising paternal streak, Godzilla tries to teach his much smaller progeny how to use his powers. The father/son team must then battle giant insects, including praying mantises and a formidable spider. Can Godzilla protect his curious tyke from the gargantuan bugs? (movie) - 1967

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
cinemaxaction.us.description: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (movie) - 1999

cinemaxaction.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemaxaction.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (movie) - 1987

cinemaxaction.us.title: Scanners
cinemaxaction.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (movie) - 1981

cinemaxaction.us.title: It
cinemaxaction.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (movie) - 1990

cinemaxaction.us.title: Life of Pi
cinemaxaction.us.description: After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi, as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive. (movie) - 2012

cinemaxaction.us.title: Take the Lead
cinemaxaction.us.description: When internationally renowned dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a teaching job in a New York City public school, he meets ridicule from the street-wise students, who scoff at the notion of ballroom dancing. Far from being discouraged, he melds their hip-hop moves with his classical style, helping them create a dance form and, in the process, becoming their mentor. (movie) - 2006

cinemaxaction.us.title: Room
cinemaxaction.us.description: Held captive for years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time. (movie) - 2015

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Enter Nowhere
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Despicable Me
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Daytrippers
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (movie) - 1996

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Nanny McPhee Returns
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Enigmatic Nanny McPhee arrives on the doorstep of a harried mother, Isabel Green, who is trying to raise her kids and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war. Isabel has her hands full of not only her own three, but also with her sister's spoiled pair. With no time to lose, McPhee uses magic to instill in the children five important lessons. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Night on Earth
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach de Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest. (movie) - 1992

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Mississippi Masala
cinemaxclassics.us.description: After Mina's Indian family is ousted from their home in Uganda by dictator Idi Amin, they relocate to Mississippi to start a new life. Mina falls for Demetrius, a young carpet cleaner, despite the protestations of their families over their racial difference. The families and their surrounding communities begin to feud, putting even more pressure on the couple's romance. Having to choose between family and love, Mina and Demetrius run away together. (movie) - 1991

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (movie) - 2001

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemaxclassics.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (movie) - 2004

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (movie) - 2007

cinemaxhits.us.title: Spring Breakers
cinemaxhits.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (movie) - 2012

cinemaxhits.us.title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
cinemaxhits.us.description: Stressed by adolescence, 16-year-old Craig Gilner (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a mental-health clinic. Unfortunately, the youth wing is closed, so he must spend his mandated five-day stay with adults. One of them, Bobby (Zach Galifianakis), quickly becomes his mentor -- and protégé, while Craig finds himself drawn to a fellow teen, Noelle (Emma Roberts), who just may be the cure he needs to forget an unrequited crush. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxhits.us.title: Game Night
cinemaxhits.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxhits.us.title: Girls Trip
cinemaxhits.us.description: Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. (movie) - 2017

cinemaxhits.us.title: Batman
cinemaxhits.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (movie) - 1989

cinemaxhits.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemaxhits.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (movie) - 1992

cinemaxhits.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemaxhits.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (movie) - 1995

cinemaxhits.us.title: Batman & Robin
cinemaxhits.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (movie) - 1997

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Transporter Refueled
cinemaxhits.us.description: Frank Martin is living a less perilous lifestyle, or so he thinks, transporting classified packages for questionable people. Things get complicated when femme fatale Anna and her three accomplices orchestrate a bank heist and the kidnapping of Frank's father. It's all part of a grand plan to take down the human trafficker who victimized her years earlier. Now a pawn in her vengeful scheme, the former special-operations mercenary must use his covert skills to play Anna's dangerous game. (movie) - 2015

cinemaxhits.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
cinemaxhits.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. (movie) - 2013

cinemaxwest.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemaxwest.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Mystery) - 2011

cinemaxwest.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemaxwest.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

cinemaxwest.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemaxwest.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Comedy drama, Biography, Docudrama) - 2023

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Biggest Little Farm
cinemaxwest.us.description: A couple are followed through their successes and failures as they work to develop a sustainable farm on 200 acres outside of Los Angeles. (Documentary) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxwest.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

cinemaxwest.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxwest.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

cinemaxwest.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxwest.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

cinemaxwest.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxwest.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Lobster
cinemaxwest.us.description: In a dystopian society, single people must find a mate within 45 days or be transformed into an animal of their choice. (Romantic comedy, Fantasy, Drama, Romance, Science fiction) - 2015

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Apparition
cinemaxwest.us.description: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror) - 2012

gameshowcentral.us.title: Baggage
gameshowcentral.us.description: Contestants on this dating game show don't want to hear the elimination line "I'm sorry, but you have too much baggage." How much is acceptable among three contestants in each episode is determined by the "dater," who hears the candidates' intimate secrets and hidden flaws, as well as their attempts to deflect these traits by describing their positive attributes. After two elimination rounds leave one remaining contestant, it's the dater's turn to reveal his or her own baggage ... and then the contestant decides to go forward with the date or not. Jerry Springer hosts. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20100419

gameshowcentral.us.title: Mind of a Man
gameshowcentral.us.description: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140108

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

gameshowcentral.us.title: Emogenius
gameshowcentral.us.description: Emojis can be polarizing, with some people constantly using the little drawings and others not caring for them. Love 'em or hate 'em, emojis can be worth money on this comedic game show. Each half-hour episode pits two pairs of contestants against each other in a battle to see which team knows emojis better. The first challenge forces the contestants to decipher a series of pop culture-inspired emoji messages. In the second round, the contestants must send each other strings of emojis that their partners must correctly guess. The winning team then advances to the bonus round, in which the teammates trade off sending and guessing rapid-fire emoji messages. If they beat the bonus round, they take home $10,000. Social media star Hunter March hosts the show, and he has game show hosting in his blood -- grandfather Hal March served as emcee on "The $64,000 Question" in the 1950s. (Show, Series, Game show, Comedy) - 20170607

gameshowcentral.us.title: Minute to Win It

The contestants on this game show hosted by Ohno have 18 seconds longer than that to complete each task in order to win a quarter of a million dollars as the grand prize. Contestants compete in as many as 10 challenges of increasing difficulty, each with a one-minute time limit, and which utilize everyday household items. Throughout the game contestants have the chance to walk away with any money earned to that point but risk losing the cash if they fail to complete a challenge within the time limit. A competitor who goes all the way and completes all 10 challenges in time, receives the $250,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20130625

golfpass.us.description: Olympic gold medalist Shaun White shares how the basics of snowboarding can translate to the golf swing.

golfpass.us.title: Golf VS - Golf Vs Snowboarding: Shaun White Part 2
golfpass.us.description: Olympic gold medalist Shaun White shares how snowboarding moves like backflips and complex tricks can translate to the golf swing.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Rory McIlroy, Part 1
golfpass.us.description: Rory McIlroy joins Brandel Chamblee on the course to share his thoughts, strategies, and overall course management in part one of this two-part episode.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Rory McIlroy, Part 2
golfpass.us.description: Rory McIlroy joins Brandel Chamblee on the course to share his thoughts, strategies, and overall course management in part two of this two-part episode. Rory shares his pre-round putting routine and goes in-depth on his green reading process.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Contact Is King
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick, kicks of The Skill Code with major championship caliber instruction, drills and tips that will be certain to have golfers play better golf.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Curve Control Is Queen
golfpass.us.description: Setup and swing keys that help you curve the ball on command.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Next Level Trajectory
golfpass.us.description: Being able to hit it high and low on command allows players to maintain precise distance control in varied conditions. Whether they're in the wind, under or over trees.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Battle Plans
golfpass.us.description: Cameron teaches how to integrate what you have learned in the first three episodes of "The Skill Code" and apply it on the golf course. He also shares course management tips.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Finese Wedges
golfpass.us.description: Cameron provides instruction to help golfers execute one of golf's most difficult shots - the short wedge shot. He helps you in understanding why contact, speed and dynamic loft will help you play your very best from 40–60 yards.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - PhD Wedge Play
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick shares his very best instruction to help golfers perfect one of golf's most difficult shots - the short wedge shot.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Greenside Vitals
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick teaches how to play those all-important stroke saving shots from around the green which include: set-up fundamentals, swing dynamics, and tour-proven drills.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Greenside Mastery
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick helps golfers understand how they can have the ability to get up and down with tour-level precision; McCormick dials in the greenside wedge play just with three-time major champion Jordan Spieth.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Swiss Army Knife Short Game
golfpass.us.description: Preparing for an assortment of difficult shots around the green with teacher Cameron McCormick.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Sand Mastery
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick brings his instruction into the bunker to help golfers enjoy their trips to the beach.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Putting Triad
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick helps golfers make more putts. Most recreational golfers are missing putts because they do not focus on the putting triad - line, speed, and read.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - PhD Putting
golfpass.us.description: Improving putting by using specific drills and games that allow you to self-detect tendencies in your game and then identify skill improvement opportunities to help you make more putts.

golfpass.us.title: Ask Rory - Masters Edition Volume 1
golfpass.us.description: Rory McIlroy answers member-submitted questions about how to swing better, shoot lower scores and have more fun with challenges on the golf course.

golfpass.us.title: Ask Rory - Masters Edition Volume 2
golfpass.us.description: Rory McIlroy answers member-submitted questions about how to swing better, shoot lower scores and have more fun with challenges on the golf course.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 6: Slice and Hook Cures
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal show which setup, swing, and equipment adjustments translate into stopping slices and hooks. Martin shares some of his favorite drills on finding the proper grip, maintaining balance, and swinging on the proper plane.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 7: Dial In Your Wedges
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the best wedge tips for around the green. Learn how to set up for success, use tees to improve contact, and how to control distance like Dustin Johnson with the use of a clock.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 8: Lessons From The Masters
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the shots needed for success in The Masters; Martin shares a driving tip he learned playing golf with Dustin Johnson and a distance drill used by Jack Nicklaus; a top college player gives a guest lesson.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 9: Putting Class
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall explains how to become a better putter ASAP; those four letters standing for aim, stability, arc, and pace. Martin shares drills for each letter from putting gurus including Dave Stockton, Phil Kenyon, and the late Frank Thomas.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 10: The Golden Bear
golfpass.us.description: 18-time Major Champion Jack Nicklaus speaks with Martin Hall about being coached at an early age by Jack Grout, his number one swing fundamental, and how to maximize distance with the driver. Favorite drills inspired by The Golden Bear.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 11: Tempo and Rhythm
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal demonstrate how to improve on tempo and rhythm. Martin discusses the difference between the two and shares tips used by Hall of Famers such as Tom Watson, Ernie Els, Vijay Singh, and Nick Faldo.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 12: U.S. Open
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the shots needed for success in the U.S. Open. Jack Nicklaus joins for an exclusive interview and shares the ball striking skill that helped him become a 4-time U.S. Open champion.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 24: Year End Special
golfpass.us.description: Find out how to crush the driver like 2021 PGA Championship winner Phil Mickelson, split the fairway under pressure like 2021 Masters champion Hideki Matsuyama, and sink breaking putts like 2021 U.S. Open Champion Jon Rahm.

golfpass.us.title: Nathalie Filler Sheehan: Breaking 100
golfpass.us.description: Nathalie Filler Sheehan shows swing fixes and strategic tips from tee to green that will help drive scores below the century mark in no time.

golfpass.us.title: Martin Hall: Breaking 90 - 90
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall brings out all the tools and analogies to help fix swing faults and poor strategies that are holding players back from shooting in the 80s.

golfpass.us.title: Martin Chuck: Breaking 80
golfpass.us.description: Martin Chuck is back with another breaking series where he will provide players with all the mental and physical tools they need to start shooting in the 70s consistently.

golfpass.us.title: Devan Bonebrake: Breaking Par - Par
golfpass.us.description: Devan Bonebrake helps players break par with drills, strategies and by following Tiger's six metrics to breaking par, which Devan was taught by his mentor Joey Wuertemberger.

golfpass.us.title: Breaking Golf's Greatest Myths - Martin Chuck - Part 1
golfpass.us.description: Martin Chuck examines a number of swing myths that have persisted over the years like "keep your head down" and "keep your lead arm straight.".

golfpass.us.title: Breaking Golf's Greatest Myths - Martin Chuck - Part 2
golfpass.us.description: Martin Chuck examines a number of swing myths that have persisted over the years like "keep your head down" and "keep your lead arm straight.".

golfpass.us.title: Breaking into the Game: Beginners - Series Preview
golfpass.us.description: Shot at The Club at Ibis, Martin Hall's new series is the definitive video golf instruction piece for beginners, providing a solid foundation for new golfers of any age.

golfpass.us.title: Breaking Your Slice With Nathalie Sheehan - Introduction
golfpass.us.description: Nathalie introduces the contributing factors of a slice and identifies the two types of slicers that exist.

golfpass.us.title: Breaking Your Slice With Nathalie Sheehan - Grip & Setup
golfpass.us.description: Nathalie introduces an error that some might be making with a grip to cause a slice; she also explains the differences between a draw setup with a driver and one with the irons.

golfpass.us.title: Build a Better Game: Bunkers - Bunker
golfpass.us.description: Sharing some tools, techniques and drills for any bunker shot.

grit.us.title: Westbound
grit.us.description: A former Union officer, John Hayes (Randolph Scott) now manages a stagecoach company. However, Clay Putnam (Andrew Duggan), a businessman still loyal to the South, is intent on robbing the coaches operated by Hayes, which transport gold to the North from California. Hoping to heist the treasure as a way to revive the Confederacy, Putnam also has a grudge against Hayes, since his wife, Norma (Virginia Mayo), was once involved with the handsome Union soldier. (Western) - 1959

grit.us.title: Major Dundee
grit.us.description: During the end of the Civil War, Major Dundee guards Confederate prisoners, Union deserters and ordinary hard-bitten criminals in a remote fort. When Apaches attack the fort and make off with three children, Dundee must set up a posse including Confederates, who face a choice between joining up or being shot. The feud between Dundee and Tyreen is also heated up by a sultry Mexican widow. (Western) - 1965

grit.us.title: The Mountain Men
grit.us.description: Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate. (Western) - 1980

grit.us.title: The Violent Men
grit.us.description: Former Union soldier John Parrish (Glenn Ford) wants to sell his ranch and start a new life by settling down out east. However, the ruthless tactics of Lew Wilkison (Edward G. Robinson), the scheming businessman interested in his property, make Parrish reconsider the move, especially after one of his ranch hands is murdered. Adding to the increasingly tense conflict is Wilkison's wife, Martha (Barbara Stanwyck), who is cheating on her husband with his brother, Cole (Brian Keith). (Western) - 1955

grit.us.title: The Tin Star
grit.us.description: Morgan Hickman is a tough gunslinger with a knack for keeping his cool in tense situations. When he wanders into a town where the local lawman has been killed, he finds callow but eager Ben Owens temporarily acting as sheriff. Soon Ben, who wants to keep his new position, is looking to Morgan for guidance. Though the bounty hunter has his own issues with law enforcement, he admires Ben's enthusiasm and decides to train him to be an effective sheriff. (Western) - 1957

grit.us.title: Joe Kidd
grit.us.description: In New Mexico, one-time bounty hunter Joe Kidd owns a ranch where a nearby group of Mexican revolutionaries, led by Luis Chama, fights for their rightful land after the U.S. government denies their claims. In response, a greedy landowner gathers a posse to capture Chama and solicits Kidd's assistance. Kidd, who has no interest in the matter, changes his mind when he discovers Chama has stolen a horse and roughed up a worker from his ranch. (Western) - 1972

grit.us.title: Two Mules for Sister Sara
grit.us.description: When gunslinger Hogan (Clint Eastwood) discovers a group of men attempting to rape a young nun, Sara (Shirley MacLaine), he shoots them dead and rescues the woman. The two escape to a nearby camp of Mexican revolutionaries, who have hired Hogan to help fight the invading French army. En route, Sara turns out to be surprisingly crude for a nun, drinking, smoking and using curse words. When she also proves to be handy with a gun, Hogan begins wondering if she is telling him the whole truth. (Western, Action, Adventure) - 1970

grit.us.title: High Plains Drifter
grit.us.description: In this Western, a drifter with no name wanders into a small town, where his gun-slinging abilities are in high demand. When the drifter rides into Lago, he is met with incredulity and disapproval by the townspeople. But once he shows his skills with a pistol, the locals realize he may be able to help them fend off a band of criminals who have been terrorizing the town. He agrees to help the townspeople, but does so with his own secret agenda. (Western) - 1973

movieplex.us.title: Starting Out in the Evening
movieplex.us.description: A complex relationship develops between Leonard (Frank Langella), an academic novelist of advancing years, and Heather (Lauren Ambrose), a determined, fresh-faced graduate student doing her master's thesis on Leonard's career. Leonard keeps everyone at an emotional distance, including his devoted daughter, Ariel (Lili Taylor), and her unsettled boyfriend, Casey (Adrian Lester). Heather's attention, although motivated by selfish interests, forces Leonard to reexamine his life. (Drama) - 2007

movieplex.us.title: Death Defying Acts
movieplex.us.description: Upon arriving in Edinburgh, Scotland for a series of mind-boggling performances, master illusionist Harry Houdini (Guy Pearce) offers an impressive cash reward to any supposed psychic who can accurately tell him his late mother's exact last words. Gorgeous swindler Mary McGarvie (Catherine Zeta-Jones) rises to the challenge and engages Houdini in a dangerous flirtation that will blur the line between reality and paranoia -- and test the very limits of his skepticism. (Drama, Romance, Thriller) - 2007

movieplex.us.title: The Great Buck Howard
movieplex.us.description: Defying his father and dropping out of law school, aspiring writer Troy Gable looks for a way to gain some meaningful life experience. Troy gets that and more when he takes a job with Buck Howard, a vainglorious mentalist who hopes to reinvigorate his fading career by staging a big comeback. (Comedy drama) - 2008

movieplex.us.title: Dudes & Dragons
movieplex.us.description: An evil, jaded wizard makes it his business to rid the realm of love. Now, a brave warrior and his reluctant brother stand between the good people of the world and a fleet of fire-breathing dragons. (Fantasy, Comedy) - 2015

movieplex.us.title: Chappaquiddick
movieplex.us.description: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious events forever alters his political legacy and changes the course of presidential history. (Thriller, Historical drama) - 2017

movieplex.us.title: The Young and Prodigious T.S. Spivet
movieplex.us.description: T.S. is invited to the Smithsonian to receive an award for inventing a perpetual motion machine. Without telling any of his family, he boards a freight train heading to Washington, D.C., to attend the ceremony. (Family, Adventure, Drama, Comedy) - 2013

movies.us.title: There Will Be Blood
movies.us.description: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy. (movie) - 2007

movies.us.title: Gangs of New York
movies.us.description: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York. (movie) - 2002

movies.us.title: The Godfather
movies.us.description: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business. (movie) - 1972

movies.us.title: The Godfather Part II
movies.us.description: The compelling sequel to "The Godfather," contrasting the life of Corleone father and son. Traces the problems of Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) in 1958 and that of a young immigrant Vito Corleone (Robert De Niro) in 1917's Hell's Kitchen. Michael survives many misfortunes and Vito is introduced to a life of crime. (movie) - 1974

movies.us.title: The Godfather, Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
movies.us.description: As Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) ages, he finds that being the head of the Corleone crime family isn't getting any easier. He wants his family out of the Mafia, but the mob kingpin (Eli Wallach) isn't eager to let one of the most powerful and wealthy families go legit. Making matters even worse is Michael's nephew, Vincent (Andy Garcia). Not only does Vincent want a piece of the Corleone family's criminal empire, but he also wants Michael's daughter, Mary (Sofia Coppola). (movie) - 1990

movies.us.title: Pulp Fiction
movies.us.description: Vincent Vega and Jules Winnfield are hitmen with a penchant for philosophical discussions. In this ultra-hip, multi-strand crime movie, their storyline is interwoven with those of their boss, gangster Marsellus Wallace; his actress wife, Mia; struggling boxer Butch Coolidge; master fixer The Wolf and a nervous pair of armed robbers, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny. (movie) - 1994

movies.us.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
movies.us.description: Evil Judge Turpin (Alan Rickman) lusts for the beautiful wife of a London barber (Johnny Depp) and transports him to Australia for a crime he did not commit. Returning after 15 years and calling himself Sweeney Todd, the now-mad man vows revenge, applying his razor to unlucky customers and shuttling the bodies down to Mrs. Lovett (Helena Bonham Carter), who uses them in her meat-pie shop. Though many fall to his blade, he will not be satisfied until he slits Turpin's throat. (movie) - 2007

movies.us.title: Chicago
movies.us.description: Nightclub sensation Velma (Catherine Zeta-Jones) murders her philandering husband, and Chicago's slickest lawyer, Billy Flynn (Richard Gere), is set to defend her. But when Roxie (Renée Zellweger) also winds up in prison, Billy takes on her case as well -- turning her into a media circus of headlines. Neither woman will be outdone in their fight against each other and the public for fame and celebrity. (movie) - 2002

screenpix.us.title: Diary of a Hitman
screenpix.us.description: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task. (Crime drama) - 1992

screenpix.us.title: Not as a Stranger
screenpix.us.description: Ambitious medical student Lucas Marsh (Robert Mitchum) aspires to being a doctor with his own practice. Unable to fund his studies himself, he woos the warm, supportive nurse Kristina (Olivia de Havilland), who has the financial resources he needs for him to realize his dreams. The couple marries and moves to a small town, where Lucas works as an assistant to Dr. Runkleman (Charles Bickford). However, after a series of betrayals, Lucas is forced to face life without the help of others. (Drama) - 1955

screenpixaction.us.title: Flight From Ashiya
screenpixaction.us.description: Stationed in Ashiya, Japan, U.S. Air Force Rescue Service members Master Sgt. Mike Takashima (Yul Brynner), Lt. Col. Glenn Stevenson (Richard Widmark) and Lt. John Gregg (George Chakiris) all carry personal demons stemming from a past event. When the orders come down to rescue stranded Japanese survivors of a shipwreck caused by a storm, the three men jump into action. On their way through the still violent storm, each shares the tale from his past that has affected him to this day. (Adventure, Drama) - 1964

screenpixaction.us.title: One Man's Hero
screenpixaction.us.description: In 1848, Jon Riley heads a group of Irish-born Roman Catholic soldiers in the U.S. Army. The group faces religious prejudice in the predominantly Protestant military. In the midst of the war against Mexico, Riley and some of his fellow soldiers go to a Catholic Church and are cruelly punished as a result. Because of this, they defect to the Mexican Army, where they meet guerrilla leader Cortina, with whom they forge an unlikely bond. (Drama) - 1999

screenpixaction.us.title: The Gallant Hours
screenpixaction.us.description: As he retires from the U.S. Navy, Admiral William J. Halsey (James Cagney) recalls the most daunting challenge in his career: the Battle of Guadalcanal in 1942. Ordered to replace a close friend as fleet admiral, Halsey faces a wily and fierce adversary in Japan's Admiral Yamamoto, and spends the grueling months of the campaign confounding expectations of both the enemy and his own staff. Pained by the losses he knows they will endure, Halsey pushes his forces to the brink. (Biography) - 1960

screenpixaction.us.title: Night Fighters
screenpixaction.us.description: An Irish rebel (Robert Mitchum) blows the whistle on Nazi collaborators in the Irish Republican Army. (War) - 1960

screenpixaction.us.title: Ambush Bay
screenpixaction.us.description: In 1944, Sgt. Steve Corey (Hugh O'Brian) leads a group of U.S. Marines on a covert mission to an island in the Philippines that is occupied by Japanese forces. There, the soldiers learn that the enemy has planted a series of mines to destroy General MacArthur's incoming troops, who are preparing to storm the island. Before the Marines get a chance to relay the information, they suffer a deadly attack, leaving only the valiant Corey and Pfc. James Grenier (James Mitchum) to save the day. (War) - 1966

screenpixaction.us.title: Submarine X-1
screenpixaction.us.description: Cmdr. Richard Bolton was in charge of a submarine that was sunk by a German ship, and he has been blamed for the loss of 50 sailors. Now exonerated of misconduct, he is heading a mission to use minisubs to reach a German battleship commanded by Capt. Erlich. During training, Bolton encounters some of his previous crew members, all of whom harbor grudges against him, which further complicates the already dangerous mission. (War) - 1968

screenpixaction.us.title: Tank Battalion
screenpixaction.us.description: During the Korean War, Sgt. Brad Dunne (Don Kelly) heads a tank battalion consisting of reluctant young recruit Pfc. Danny Collins (Bob Padget) and seasoned soldiers Corp. Corbett (Edward G. Robinson Jr.) and Pfc. Madigan (Frank Gorshin). When guerrillas launch a series of ambushes on a U.S. base camp, Dunne and his men are ordered to lead an offensive against the rebels. But, just as they approach the front lines, a grenade blast disables their tank, stranding them as the enemy approaches. (War) - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: Matchless
screenpixaction.us.description: A New York journalist (Patrick O'Neal) plays global spy with an ancient ring that makes him invisible. (Comedy) - 1967

screenpixaction.us.title: Salt and Pepper
screenpixaction.us.description: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. They find her diary and, pursuing the case on their own, discover a sinister plot to overthrow the British government, masterminded by a certain Col. Woodstock (John Le Mesurier). Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot. (Comedy) - 1968

screenpixaction.us.title: Topkapi
screenpixaction.us.description: Beautiful thief Elizabeth Lipp (Melina Mercouri) and criminal genius Walter Harper (Maximilian Schell) put together a plan to steal an emerald-encrusted dagger from Istanbul's Topkapi Palace. As part of their crew, they hire small-time hustler Arthur Simon Simpson (Peter Ustinov) to act as their fall guy. When the Turkish secret police capture Simpson at the border, they persuade him to spy on his partners in crime, mistakenly believing that they're Communist agents plotting an assassination. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1964

screenpixvoices.us.title: Truck Turner
screenpixvoices.us.description: Bounty hunter Mack "Truck" Turner (Isaac Hayes) almost always finds his target, but his latest prize -- a pimp called Gator (Paul Harris) -- is killed while Turner is chasing him. Gator's girl, Dorinda (Nichelle Nichols), vows to avenge his death and offers ownership of her successful call-girl operation to anyone who can knock off Turner. Upscale pimp Harvard Blue (Yaphet Kotto) steps in, upping the ante with professional assassins. Turner, however, isn't going down easily. (movie) - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: Friday Foster
screenpixvoices.us.description: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt. (movie) - 1975

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Monkey Hustle
screenpixvoices.us.description: Slick Chicago street hustler Big Daddy Foxx (Yaphet Kotto) lives comfortably off petty confidence scams that he pulls with the help of loyal teenage acolytes Baby D' (Kirk Calloway), Tiny (Donn Harper) and Player (Thomas Carter). His business is jeopardized, however, when he runs afoul of neighborhood racketeer Goldie (Rudy Ray Moore). Their rivalry escalates until the threat of a freeway being built through their neighborhood obliges them to cooperate in order to fight city hall. (movie) - 1976

screenpixvoices.us.title: Drum
screenpixvoices.us.description: A slaver (Warren Oates) buys Drum (Ken Norton), a bordello queen's (Silvia Pinal) son, in the 1860s New Orleans. (movie) - 1976

screenpixvoices.us.title: Across 110th Street
screenpixvoices.us.description: After a robbery in Harlem turns into a scene of mass murder, promising young black police officer William Pope (Yaphet Kotto) is assigned to the case, along with surly, prejudiced Italian-American cop Frank Mattelli (Anthony Quinn). The pair clashes during their tense investigation as they try to track down the three suspects and apprehend them. Also searching for the fugitives is ruthless mobster Nick D'Salvio (Tony Franciosa), who will stop at nothing to retrieve the stolen money. (movie) - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: Truck Turner
screenpixvoices.us.description: Bounty hunter Mack "Truck" Turner (Isaac Hayes) almost always finds his target, but his latest prize -- a pimp called Gator (Paul Harris) -- is killed while Turner is chasing him. Gator's girl, Dorinda (Nichelle Nichols), vows to avenge his death and offers ownership of her successful call-girl operation to anyone who can knock off Turner. Upscale pimp Harvard Blue (Yaphet Kotto) steps in, upping the ante with professional assassins. Turner, however, isn't going down easily. (movie) - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: Friday Foster
screenpixvoices.us.description: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt. (movie) - 1975

screenpixvoices.us.title: Census Taker
screenpixvoices.us.description: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective. (movie) - 1984

screenpixvoices.us.title: Carbon Copy
screenpixvoices.us.description: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot. (movie) - 1981

screenpixvoices.us.title: Amazing Grace
screenpixvoices.us.description: A feisty old woman (Moms Mabley) forces moral support on a big-city candidate (Moses Gunn) for mayor. (movie) - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: Five on the Black Hand Side
screenpixvoices.us.description: Mr. Brooks (Leonard Jackson) is an African-American barbershop owner who runs his household with an iron fist. One day, however, Mrs. Brooks (Clarice Taylor) tires of his stern approach and embraces a nonconformist attitude that's more in line with that of their children, including the philosophical Booker T. (D'Urville Martin) and Gideon (Glynn Turman), a black militant. Soon a battle of wills erupts in the Brooks household, and no one is going to readily back down. (movie) - 1973

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Spikes Gang
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Will (Gary Grimes), Les (Ron Howard) and Tod (Charlie Martin Smith), teenage farm boys living near the Mexican border, stumble upon Harry Spikes (Lee Marvin), a local bandit near death in the middle of nowhere. After helping bring the aging man back to health, the trio decide to escape their humdrum lives by becoming outlaws themselves. Failing at their first attempt to rob a bank, the boys convince the gruff Spikes to teach them the ways of the desperado. (movie) - 1974

screenpixwesterns.us.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault. (movie) - 1974

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Wild Horse Stampede
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson) stop horse rustlers for Indians and a railroad. (movie) - 1943

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Broken Star
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Deputy Marshal Frank Smeed (Howard Duff) guns down an innocent Mexican who was about to deliver a huge sum of gold to a land tycoon, then makes off with the loot and covers his tracks by claiming that the man he shot was a dangerous criminal. Deputy Marshal Bill Gantry (Bill Williams) is charged with investigating the matter to ensure that his close friend Smeed was in the right. When he gets too close to discovering the truth, the crooked deputy tries to make Gantry his next victim. (movie) - 1956

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Pioneer Woman
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In this 19th-century drama, an American family from the Northeast heads to Wyoming in search of a better life, only to face tragedy and hardship. Maggie Sergeant (Joanna Pettet), the hard-driving matriarch of the clan, is totally unprepared when her husband, John (William Shatner), is murdered. Left to handle the farm on her own, Maggie must choose whether to stay in Wyoming and run the farm with her children, or head back to the East Coast and the life she knows. (movie) - 1973

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Westward Bound
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Corrupt politician Albert Lane (Weldon Heyburn), town councilor Roger Caldwell (Harry Woods) and tax agent Henry Wagner (Karl Hackett) plot to steal the land of Montana ranchers. The ranchers, led by feisty Jasper Tuttle (Hal Price) and Enid Barrett (Betty Miles), band together to fight back. With the help of a trio of virtuous U.S. marshals called the Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson, Bob Steele), the honest ranchers tangle with the politicians' henchmen. (movie) - 1944

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Arizona Whirlwind
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson, Bob Steele) shoot it out with a gang of diamond thieves. (movie) - 1944

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Powderkeg
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A pair of troubleshooting investigators must help recover a hijacked train that has 73 hostages aboard. (movie) - 1971

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Death Valley Rangers
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson, Bob Steele) catch hijackers of stagecoach gold shipments. (movie) - 1943

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Stagecoach
screenpixwesterns.us.description: An outlaw (Kris Kristofferson), a gambler (Waylon Jennings), Doc Holliday (Willie Nelson) and other passengers have Geronimo's war party for company. (movie) - 1986

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Whiskey and Ghosts
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Davy Crockett's ghost appears and wanders around what looks like the West. (movie) - 1976

screenpixwesterns.us.title: God Forgives, I Don't
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Psychotic bandit Bill San Antonio kills all the passengers on a train and steals a fortune in gold. Hutch Bessy, an insurance investigator, and his gunslinger partner, Cat Stevens, go on the hunt for Bill, hoping to retrieve the loot. Unfortunately, outlaws take Hutch and Cat prisoner. Cat manages to get away and saves Hutch's life. When Cat is kidnapped later by other crooks, Hutch has to reciprocate. But they still have Bill to worry about. (movie) - 1967

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Hills Run Red
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Confederate soldiers Jerry Brewster (Thomas Hunter) and Ken Seagull (Nando Gazzolo) steal a fortune from the U.S. Army. But, when the partners in crime are ambushed by Union troops, they have to split up; Seagull escapes with the money, and Brewster gets a five-year jail sentence. When Brewster gets out, he discovers that his old crony is responsible for the death of his beloved wife. With the help of a gunslinger named Getz (Dan Duryea), Brewster embarks on a quest for vengeance. (movie) - 1966

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Adiós, Sabata
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) allies himself with a group of wily Mexican revolutionaries scheming to overthrow Emperor Maximilian and expel the occupying Austrians from their homeland. Part of their plan involves stealing a shipment of gold and using it to purchase artillery. It won't be easy, however, as the gold is under the protection of the corrupt and sadistic Col. Skimmel (Gerard Herter). As Sabata pulls off the daring heist, he must take on dozens of enraged Austrian forces. (movie) - 1970

showtime.us.title: Reindeer Games
showtime.us.description: Just released from prison, all Rudy Duncan (Ben Affleck) wants is to start a new life with Ashley (Charlize Theron), the girl of his dreams, whom he met through pen pal letters in prison. But between them and happiness stands her crazy brother, Gabriel (Gary Sinise), and his motley crew of deadly criminals who think Rudy has some inside information about a casino where he once had a job -- a casino Gabriel and his short-fused posse plan to take down. (Crime drama)

showtime.us.title: Pike River
showtime.us.description: On Nov. 19, 2010, a coal mine explosion in New Zealand kills Anna Osborne's husband and Sonya Rockhouse's son, along with 27 other men. The two women soon embark on a quest for truth and justice, leading to change they never thought possible. (Drama)

showtime.us.title: Yellowjackets
showtime.us.description: "Yellowjackets" tells the narrative of a team of wildly talented high-school girls soccer players who survive a plane crash deep in the Ontario wilderness. The series chronicles their descent from a complicated but thriving team to warring, cannibalistic clans, while also tracking the lives they have attempted to piece back together. Sophie Nélisse, Jasmin Savoy Brown, Sophie Thatcher and Sammi Hanratty star as the teenagers, while Melanie Lynskey, Tawny Cypress, Christina Ricci and Juliette Lewis portray their adult counterparts as they reveal the truth about their survival 25 years later. (Drama)
